title: The Alpha Princess Is Gone for Good
description: A fantasy-werewolf vertical series following an alpha princess who walks away from her pack and title for good — and everything that comes apart once she does.
descriptionMore: When the pack's princess finally leaves rather than keep bending to its expectations, the fallout reaches further than anyone expected: old loyalties fracture, rivals circle, and the people who underestimated her are forced to reckon with what she's capable of once she's no longer playing by pack rules. Told across 55 vertical episodes.
